name: Monster In The Forest
source:
Your name is Yule, and you don't know why, but you just walked really far into the forest near your hometown. It would be fine if you hadn't heard rumors of a monster here.

[From [url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/monster-in-the-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你叫Yule，不知为何，已经走进家乡附近的森林深处。如果没听过这里有怪物的传闻，倒也不算什么。

[摘自[url=https://melancolymilk.itch.io/monster-in-the-forest]itch.io[/url]]
